newsitem.title: FRANCE: Cap rises on 1996 results, broker upgrade.
newsitem.headline: Cap rises on 1996 results, broker upgrade.

text.p: Shares in computer systems house Cap Gemini rose on Wednesday, boosted by 1996 results and an earnings upgrade by broker Cheuvreux de Virieu, fund managers and analysts said.
Cap was up 7.65 percent at 333.7 francs on volume of 253,959 shares at 1159 GMT. The stock has gained 32 percent since the start of the year.
Fund managers said Cheuvreux has revised its earnings per share forecast to nine francs for 1997 from eight and 12.5 for 1998 from 11.5.
Cap reported on Tuesday 1996 net attributable profit rose to 280 million francs from 52 million in 1995.
Net profit per share was 4.64 francs per share versus 0.99. Operating profit rose to 1.04 billion francs from 678 million.
